expected_effect: Reproduce the normal-request regression in a bounded exact eight-expert replay, then choose the smallest scheduling or surrounding-compute intervention.

limitations: Eight fixed experts across four layers and saved input rows, not complete requests. No tokens-per-second or sustained-coding claim.
